notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.content:
TV Power on/off button label stays consistent after sleeping
 finishing the game now returns you to the main menu instead of closing the game
 spam report resets when sleeping instead of repeating itself
 windows icon fixed

notes.title: Hot Fix #3
notes.content:
achievements are now achievable 
 can no longer walk into the void and beyond
 the letter properly hides itself
 "RESUME" button goes back to "START" if progress is reset
 "RESET PROGRESS" button actually resets progress
 replaced the clock batteries
 minor amendments to the content file


Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs in the past days. Your efforts are greatly appreciated.

Artificial Entertainment

notes.title: Hot Fix #1, 2
notes.content:
renamed letter object from "Channel 4 to "Letter"
 "Save & Exit" is now "Save & Return"
 Added a "delete save file" for those who wish to replay the game
 fps limit renamed from "0", to "UNLIMITED"
 translation error in one of the dialogues fixed


Thank you all for the day 1 bug reports,
Artificial Entertainment
